question: As per MOSPI report of 2024, the female population of India by 2036 will be _______ of total population.
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.488**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MOSPI)** released a report projecting that the **female population of India** by **2036** will constitute **0.488** (or approximately 48.8%) of the total population. 
• This projection is based on the **population growth trends** and the **sex ratio** at birth, which has been improving due to various government initiatives and societal changes. 
• As per the **2024 MOSPI report**, the estimated total population of India by 2036 will be approximately **1.52 billion**, with females accounting for a significant proportion of this population. 
• The value **0.488** highlights that, while close to equal, the female population will still be slightly less than the male population. 
• This projection aligns with the **United Nations' World Population Prospects**, which also emphasizes the gradual **narrowing of the gender gap** in India's population.
